underSpecifications.recommendedCorrectionLater: Add explicit input_contract fields in a later package correction task: inconsistency_compartment, involved_models, conformance_status, consistency_status, evidence_refs and source_trace.

criticalRulesReviewed.notes: D2 is correctly used as primary pathology mapping authority.
D1/EVE-00 correctly gate conformance and consistency before pathology mapping.
No final diagnosis, IR, registry, export, monetization or transduction.
Primary candidate is conservative and preserves all candidates when multiple compartments fire.
Systemic total requires all four views and cascade evidence.
Tortura Causal and Violación Causal remain distinct.
Falsa Elección is limited to alternatives/gateway mismatch.
Aliases do not increase canonical pathology count.
UI does not expose pathology labels.
Downstream receives governed candidates, not raw text.
